<!-- clawsweeper-pr-ack:opened item=139306 -->
🦞👀
ClawSweeper picked this up.

Pull request received. I will update this pull request when review starts.

Land-ready at `b940ec041a4b9409f0f75b5d475b314fe12ce0c8`: [CI33986896822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/33986896822) completed successfully. Native review artifacts validate and independent Codex review is clean through P2.

The report contract and fixed Control UI renderer reuse existing board storage. Mock runtime code and duplicate widget/progress lifecycle code are removed. Production TS/CSS is -62 lines, or -54 including generated metadata. Existing HTML/registered/MCP behavior remains; no schema/configuration migration or automatic HTML conversion.

Local proof includes the full pre-rebase changed gate, 177 refreshed focused UI cases, five production-browser cases, and 32 final real-store/HTTP/sandbox comparison loads. The CI correction removes obsolete test setup only: all40 affected cases and explicit-root type-aware lint pass; production is unchanged from the measured commit.

Exact local commands included:

```sh
env -u OPENCLAW_TESTBOX node scripts/check-changed.mjs --staged
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs --config ui/vitest.config.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane-board.test.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.ui.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/ui.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --config .oxlintrc.json --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json --disable-nested-config --threads=1 ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane-board.test.ts
```

The inspected before/after captures and detailed measurements are in the PR body. The refreshed timings are mixed: native eliminates both iframe contexts and updates in place, but this does not establish a general first-load speedup. The local transport/bootstrap mocks and absence of a production deployment are explicitly recorded.

@clawsweeper review

Please review the current head, `b940ec041a4b9409f0f75b5d475b314fe12ce0c8`. The native merge gate requires a completed review; the PR currently has only the initial acknowledgment. CI is green, and the PR body contains inspected browser proof, the production LOC breakdown, and the mixed performance results without a general speedup claim.

Merged as [e90a3baabc14](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e90a3baabc14ca1639b68514b76a90b090ee567e) through the native workflow. Exact-head CI 33986896822 and the completed ClawSweeper review passed; the merge receipt is retained.

LOC accounting clarification: the automated Source +105 table treats the 159-line move from runtime `mock-ops.ts` into test support as neutral. Those lines are no longer shipped in the production import graph. Reclassifying that move yields **-54 production lines including generated metadata**, or **-62 TS/CSS lines**, as detailed in the PR body.

The native report capability and in-place updates are verified. The refreshed first-load timings remain mixed; no general speedup or production deployment is claimed.

Operational follow-up: the batch review publisher in run 33987209223 hit its 12-minute comment-sync budget after processing 18 of 61 selected items (17 synced), before reaching this PR. The dedicated exact-review queue completed publication and satisfied the merge gate.

Follow-up performance verification of the native report path on [f8b43dc795f2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f8b43dc795f28a58efce1131713f4b553dbb9d95):

| Viewport | Native paint median | Native slowest | HTML composed-frame bound median |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Desktop, 1440×1000 | 536 ms | 596 ms | 626.4 ms |
| Mobile-sized, 390×844 | 536 ms | 600 ms | 612.9 ms |

Seven measured loads per format and viewport, alternating formats after predeclared warmups. Every measured native load was below one second. All 28 measured cases passed complete report-content checks and actual trusted Details-link activation. Native also passed its two warmups at 688/664 ms.

This used a real isolated Gateway, normal authentication and HTTP/WebSocket traffic, shipped Brotli assets, fresh browser contexts, 2,000 synthetic sessions, and identical five-block reports in the ordinary split layout. The Linux [Testbox workflow](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/33993565671) reported four AMD EPYC logical CPUs; Chromium was 151.0.7922.34, without explicit browser CPU/network throttling. Native timing uses browser Element Timing for the visible title and three metric values, with complete-DOM and visibility gates. HTML timing is explicitly an upper bound. This is loopback proof, not live-site or physical-phone verification.

The overall run intentionally remains **nonzero**: one predeclared desktop HTML warmup had complete DOM but no inner paint entries and was retained as a telemetry failure. There were 31 successful cases and that one failure; it was not reclassified as a pass. Earlier mobile HTML interaction failures were traced to pointerdown landing on the outer iframe without an inner anchor click. Post-paint scroll/hover verification and a normal trusted click without further scrolling resolved that input-delivery problem in every final measured case; sandbox restrictions were unchanged.

The previous polling-based ready detector was not a reliable paint clock—for example, one calibration painted native content at 676 ms but was detected at 1,079.5 ms. Hardware, transport and layout also differ, so these numbers are not presented as a runtime speedup ratio against the earlier harness.

No additional application patch was needed. This PR remains merged, with the verified overall production delta of **−54 lines**. Attached captures were inspected and contain synthetic data only.
